# Respiratory viruses

> *Viruses that infect the airway and spread in respiratory particles, most of them enveloped RNA viruses with short incubation periods.*

::: {.callout-note}
## In preparation
The plan for this chapter:
:::

| Part of the chapter | Plan |
|---|---|
| Learning objectives | Describe the group by its traits; explain one mechanism of harm for each main virus; recognise the enabling conditions that point to each |
| The group in one sentence | Viruses that infect the airway and spread in respiratory particles, most of them enveloped RNA viruses with short incubation periods. |
| Main viruses | Influenza virus (anchor); SARS-CoV-2; respiratory syncytial virus |
| Supporting viruses | Rhinoviruses, adenoviruses, measles virus |
| Later in the course | Respiratory block; vaccines in immunology; antivirals in pharmacology |
| Scenario questions | Most likely virus, with options restricted to the group; feedback names the discriminating clue |
